assumptions.assumption: The per-account average balance uses all large transactions of the account, including those with VYBER, other or missing types. Accounts whose large transactions are all unsigned are therefore skipped only for the first figure and still count toward the second.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Large' includes the cutoff itself, so amount >= 2400.

assumptions.assumption: 'Large' means amount >= 2400, so the cutoff value is included.

The per-account average balance uses all of the account's large transactions, including those whose type is VYBER, NULL or other and so are left out of the signed amount. Accounts with no signed amount are skipped only in the first average, because AVG ignores NULLs, and still count in the second.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Large' means strictly greater than 2400, so the cutoff value is excluded.

assumptions.assumption: A transaction is 'large' when amount >= 2400, so the cutoff value itself is included.

Each account's average balance is taken over all of its large transactions, including those with other or missing types (e.g. VYBER). Only the signed-amount average excludes them. Accounts whose large transactions are all of other types therefore still count in the balance average, while the signed-amount average skips them.

alternatives.interpretation: Large means strictly greater than 2400 (cutoff value excluded).
